args.prompt: Plain flat uniform chroma-green background, locked-off camera, no camera movement, no cuts, MEDIUM-WIDE shot framed EXACTLY like the reference image: same camera distance, same size of the man in frame, head near the top third, clasped hands visible at the bottom edge; do NOT zoom in. The man from the reference image speaks the audio line to camera with dry wit. His enormous waxed handlebar moustache completely covers his mouth at all times; the mouth is NEVER visible; the moustache, cheeks and jaw move exactly in sync with every syllable as he talks underneath it. One eyebrow rises, one elegant open-palm gesture, small nods. Same black turtleneck, charcoal blazer, oxblood pocket square, brass viewfinder. Eyes never wide.
